draft.subject: A quick hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

You've already got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the hard part -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work you're tracking is usually the next step that makes things click.

If it would help, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that next step with you. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
